title: New West Maui wells timeline
summary: On September 17, staff presented a timeline for new West Maui water source projects, as the director had said in July would happen. The Kahana well is projected to finish in the fourth quarter of this year and the H2 well in early 2032, with several wells on overlapping timelines. Staff said the L1 and H1 wells are fully funded and all four wells will be paid for through federal grants or the water system development fund.

timeline.text: Staff said the four wells are a top priority for West Maui residents, for reliable water for fire protection and peak demand.
Staff said all four wells will be funded through federal grants or the department's water system development fund.
Staff said the L1 and H1 wells are fully funded.
The well called H2 is projected to be finished in early 2032.
The Kahana well is projected to be finished in the fourth quarter of this year.
The water department is working on several new West Maui wells on overlapping timelines.
A board member asked to add the West Maui well schedule and desalination report release to a future agenda.
The director said a West Maui well development schedule should be presented in September.
